notes.title: Update 2.0 - Droid Guier
notes.notes:
Droid Guier now with its new update 2.0, changes the gameplay, readjusting the levels, tutorial to play on the keyboard and also on the Joystick.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38076288/e9988db14117b446f2daff0861ced0f09ec3dba9.png


The new version allows you to never be unarmed, after losing everything, the player has time to recover his ammo. It was even more enjoyable to play, check it out!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38076288/7be925c34bca51414619fe3008f08866d61811fc.png


Allow to prove the challenges that Droid Guier is, find out if you are able to destroy your enemies and solve the puzzles.

Changing phases allows for more dynamics and varieties.
